name: Power Through Decay
body:
School transmutation; Level death mage 3, shaman 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, witch 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target self
Duration 1 round/level (D)

DESCRIPTION

You sacrifice your own physical heath for more mental and magical power. You gain a +6 bonus to your Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma. For the duration however, you take 1 damage to your Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution each round at the beginning of your turn. You cannot cast this spell if your are immune to ability damage.
